title: Blanch vegetables before freezing
summary: Use the tested time and immediate cooling needed to protect frozen quality.
steps: Find the exact blanching method and time for the vegetable and cut size.
Bring the specified water or steam system to full operating condition before adding a measured batch.
Start timing only as directed after the process returns to the required condition.
Transfer immediately to abundant cold or ice water for the specified cooling period.
Drain thoroughly before packing; under-blanching and over-blanching both reduce quality.
